name: Bay Area Vanpool Program
description: $600/month discount on Enterprise vanpools, empty-seat subsidies, and free tolls for larger vanpools
fullDescription: The Bay Area Vanpool Program (through 511.org) helps commuters form and join vanpools, where groups of 7-15 people share a van for their daily commute, splitting costs and reducing traffic.
whatTheyOffer:
- $600 monthly discount on Commute with Enterprise vanpool rentals
- Help finding or starting a vanpool
- "Empty seat" subsidies for owner-operated vanpools
- Free bridge tolls for larger vanpools (11-15 passengers)
- Help signing up for discounted parking in San Francisco and Oakland
- HOV lane access; extra benefits may be available from your county
howToGetIt:
1. Visit 511.org's Vanpool page
2. If you don't own a van, contact Commute with Enterprise to join or start a vanpool
3. If you own a 7-15 passenger van, learn about starting an owner-operated vanpool
4. Split monthly costs with vanpool members (usually month-to-month)
5. Ask your employer about vanpool subsidies or pre-tax commuter benefits
keywords: vanpool, 511, commute, rideshare, HOV, carpool, subsidy, employer, group van, shared ride
